unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI and EVI as dimensionless indices, stored with a scale factor of 0.0001
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Multiply `NDVI` or `EVI` by 0.0001 to obtain physical index values. Screen pixels with `SummaryQA` for routine filtering, or `DetailedQA` when specific quality bits matter. `sur_refl_b01` through `sur_refl_b07` carry the contributing surface reflectances at the same scale; `ViewZenith`, `SolarZenith` and `RelativeAzimuth` are in degrees with a 0.01 scale. `DayOfYear` gives the Julian day of each composite, which matters when reducing 16-day observations to annual statistics.

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: MOD13A2 Collection 6/6.1 1 km 16-day NDVI or EVI is admitted; MOD13Q1/A1/A3/C1, the Aqua MYD13 series, SPOT VEGETATION, PROBA-V and GIMMS products are excluded.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy defines which product counts as the anchor, not whether a paper may also use other vegetation-index products. A study comparing several sensors is admissible as long as the admitted 1 km 16-day MODIS surface is itself operationally processed.

substituted_for.paper_used: SPOT VEGETATION NDVI at 1 km, annual maximum-value composites over 2000-2015, obtained from the Chinese Academy of Sciences RESDC
substituted_for.reason: The Earth Engine catalog publishes no SPOT VEGETATION NDVI. Only SPOT high-resolution imagery limited to Brazil and PROBA-V top-of-canopy reflectance from 2013 onward exist, neither of which is the 1 km annual NDVI series the source used.
substituted_for.why_this_substitute: MOD13A2 is the only catalog collection that satisfies all three requirements at once: 1 km grid matching the source and its co-registered covariates, 16-day cadence fine enough to reproduce annual maximum-value compositing, and coverage from February 2000 spanning the 2000-2015 study period.

rejected_alternatives.MODIS/061/MOD13A3: 1 km but monthly-composited, so annual maximum-value compositing loses its meaning
rejected_alternatives.MODIS/061/MOD13Q1: 250 m, does not match the 1 km grid of the source and its covariates
rejected_alternatives.NASA/GIMMS/3GV0: 9.3 km is far too coarse, and the record ends in 2013 before the study period closes
rejected_alternatives.VITO/PROBAV/C1/S1_TOC_333M: starts in 2013, cannot cover 2000-2015, and carries reflectance rather than a published NDVI series

substituted_for.residual_gap: MODIS and SPOT VEGETATION differ in sensor, band placement and compositing, so absolute NDVI values are not interchangeable with the source; only the 1 km annual-maximum construction is preserved.

directions.research_question: 如何融合 AMSR2、MODIS 和 ERA5 等异构数据，并利用机器学习提高陆地上空可降水量的估计精度？

directions.variables_and_data_use: 论文使用 AMSR2 亮温及其波段比值、MOD21A1N 地表温度、MOD13A2 提供的 NDVI，以及 ERA5 的总柱水汽、总柱可降水量、气温、露点温度和其他变量作为 PWV 模型输入；使用 Radiosonde 数据训练模型，并使用 Radiosonde 和 GNSS 观测进行验证。
directions.method_paradigm: 机器学习测量反演与验证
directions.evidence_granularity: GPT admitted with verified quote; Qwen initially admitted but quote guard downgraded to uncertain

source_paper.title: Enhanced Retrieval of Precipitable Water Vapor Over Land: An Approach for Algorithmic Improvement and Performance Assessment
source_paper.venue: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing

directions.research_question: 研究问题是2013至2022年Nyungwe National Park的植被覆盖如何发生时空变化，以及这种变化与地表温度和降雨变异有何关系。
directions.hypothesis_or_mechanism: 研究假设是植被下降与气候变异显著相关，且边缘和缓冲区域的植被退化比核心森林更明显。
directions.variables_and_data_use: 使用MODIS MOD13A2 v6.1计算年度NDVI并分析趋势，使用MODIS MOD11A2 v6.1提供地表温度，使用CHIRPS v2.0 Daily计算年度降雨总量，并通过Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS进行验证；同时使用WDPA_WDOECM_Feb2026定义公园边界。
directions.method_paradigm: 变化检测与关系机制分析
directions.evidence_granularity: GPT admitted with verified quote; Qwen initially admitted but quote guard downgraded to uncertain

source_paper.title: Spatio-Temporal Assessment of Vegetation Cover Changes in Nyungwe National Park, Rwanda (2013–2022): Implications for Conservation Management

quality.basis: Recomputed counts only; historical coverage/assessment labels are not copied.
